title: Guided: order parcels for loading

ticket.subject: Loading order
ticket.body: Each parcel is a (name, kg) pair. Return the names in loading order, with the heaviest parcel first. Parcels with the same weight go A to Z by name.

rules: Return the names only, as a list.
Parcels with the same weight are ordered A to Z by name.

title: Guided: weight per dock

ticket.subject: Weight per dock
ticket.body: Each parcel is a (dock, kg) pair. Return a dict from each dock to the total kg of its parcels. An empty list gives an empty dict.

rules: Each dock maps to the total kg of its parcels.
An empty list gives an empty dict, not None.

title: Guided: how deep is a nested list?

ticket.subject: Nesting depth
ticket.body: A value that is not a list has depth 0. A list has one more than the deepest item inside it, so an empty list has depth 1.

rules: A value that is not a list has depth 0.
A list has one more than the deepest item inside it, so an empty list has depth 1.
